email: Hi there, I hope you're doing well. I'm the finance coordinator for our marketing agency and we've been using Taskline for about two years now across three different teams, which has honestly been a huge help for keeping our campaigns organized, especially during our busiest quarter last fall when we were juggling five client launches at once. Anyway, the reason I'm writing is that when I was reconciling our books this month I noticed that our annual renewal charge came in about $340 higher than what we paid last year, and I don't remember getting any notice about a price increase or a change in the number of seats on our plan.
